name: Flame Tongue

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Always ablaze while you hold it: an extra 2d6 Fire on every hit, and it lights the area.
text: Flames wrap the blade or head whenever you hold the weapon, with no command word and no Bonus Action to spend. While it burns, each hit adds 2d6 Fire damage, and the weapon lights up Bright Light out to 40 feet with Dim Light another 40 feet beyond. Put it away and the fire goes out; draw it and it burns again.
